original_test_intent: Validate that every Type 45 Version Format byte correctly describes its paired Firmware Version representation and remains stable across an approved reboot.
original_method: Collect full Type45 structures and strings read-only, validate offset/layout support, resolve the adjacent version string, interpret the format byte, correlate component identity and compare pre/post reboot; never run the same-code multi-flash overlay.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected format/component map and reboot; all field decoding and comparison are automated. No firmware flashing belongs to this variant.
required_inputs: SMBIOS Type45 capability and reserved/OEM format policy
Validated parser and read-only firmware inventory
safety_requirements: Quarantine AFULnx, afuefix64.efi, image and flash-loop instructions because they belong to a different same-code row.
Read only; do not update firmware or change boot/BMC/component state.
Preserve raw format byte and paired string; normalize only under the declared format.
Stop on management-health loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type45 bounds, version string index and format byte for each record; correlate component and compare semantic pre/post state.
Record variant separation and any reserved/OEM or version-format mismatch without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve component/version/format policy, variant identity and reboot plan.
Adjudicate OEM format exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: it is a destructive flash workflow copied from another same-code variant and must not run.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only read-only raw/decoded Type45 and firmware inventory collection; emit handle, version string/index, format byte, component mapping and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The row's Type45 scope, script and 5/5-minute values are preserved; the incompatible flash overlay is retained as provenance but quarantined.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode each raw Version Format with its paired Firmware Version and component identity, validate against approved policy and compare after reboot while binding execution to this row variant.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory-source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 45 Firmware Version and Version Format definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects the same-code overlay collision and adds explicit format/string/component validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers reserved/OEM encodings and wrong-component or wrong-variant evidence without introducing a firmware write.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved component/version/format map and variant selection.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM encodings require owner semantics; the duplicate code cannot identify this case without source row and variant ID.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define accepted OEM formats and reboot method, but may not reinterpret this read-only SMBIOS case as a flash endurance test; the other same-code rows remain separately reviewable.
expected_evidence: Variant identity and explicit flash-overlay quarantine
Raw pre/post Type45 records and paired string/format fields
Decoded format validity and component mapping

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The master Items/Procedure/Criteria consistently describe a read-only Type45 field check; the conflicting flash content is a prior AI overlay and same-code collision, not an ambiguity in the master source. It is retained and rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact row and variant resolve the collision, and the intended read-only format check is fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its quarantine and field semantics while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Binds execution to source row/variant and separates readiness, status and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an SMBIOS metadata check from accidentally invoking a BIOS-flash endurance workflow solely because three rows share one code.
independent_technical_reasoning: Version Format is a read-only Type45 discriminator coupled to a version string; a flash loop neither validates that relation nor preserves the requested safety and therefore cannot be treated as the method for this variant.
